LanguageData.MAP_StoryStyle_Classic.label: Classic
LanguageData.MAP_StoryStyle_Classic.description: The classic gameplay experience. No additional storylines are enabled, allowing a completely free mechanoid colony experience.
LanguageData.MAP_StoryStyle_SymbiosisCovenant.label: Symbiosis covenant
LanguageData.MAP_StoryStyle_SymbiosisCovenant.descrip: Play as a mechanoid freed from the cerebrex's control. Gradually earn other factions' trust through mutually beneficial actions, establish common defense, and invite them to join a Symbiosis covenant against the cerebrex.
LanguageData.MAP_StoryStyle_PurgeDirective.label: Purge directive
LanguageData.MAP_StoryStyle_PurgeDirective.descriptio: Play as a killing machine deployed by the cerebrex, ruthlessly clearing all intelligent organic beings. Earn the cerebrex's trust through tasks to gain the mechanoid hive's support.
LanguageData.MAP_StoryStyle_Custom.label: Custom
LanguageData.MAP_StoryStyle_Custom.description: Freely combine the story components enabled in this game.
